title: Interest redemption failed
description: This event occurs when a quota redemption fails

account_id.title: Account identifier
account_id.description: A custom account ID string that uniquely identifies the account within client organization

reason_code.title: Reason code
reason_code.description: Code of the business rule that refused the redemption

message.title: Error message
message.description: Description of the business rule that refused the redemption
examples: quota status must be ACTIVE, was REDEEMED
